senses.gloss: झलक्का झलक्का, f. a large flame.

झल्लक झल्लक, अम्, n. (fr. झल्ल, imitative
sound), cymbals; (ई), f. a kind of drum.

झलज्झला झलज्झला, f. an onomatopoetic
word for the noise of falling drops, the flapping of
an elephant's ears, or of flaccid breasts, &c.

झलरी झलरी, f. = झर्झर, a sort of
drum; a curl; [cf. झल्लरी.]

झल्लरी झल्लरी, f. (fr. झल्ल, imitative
sound; cf. झलरी), a kind of musical instrument,
a sort of drum or cymbal; a curl, a lock of hair;
moisture; purity; a ball &c. of perfumed substances
used for cleaning the hair; [cf. झलरी and झिल्लरी.]

झालरी झालरी [cf. झलरी], a kind of drum
or tabor.

झला झला, f. a girl, a daughter; sun-
shine, splendor, brilliant or glittering light; a cricket;
[cf. झिल्ली; cf. also rt. ज्वल्; Hib. gal, ‘heat;’
galla, ‘fairness, brightness, beauty;’ gallad, ‘a lass,
a young girl.’]

झल्ल झल्ल, अस्, m. a prize-fighter, a cudgel-
player, a man of a tribe following the profession of
a Jhalla; a designation of one of the degraded classes
sprung from an outcast Kṣatriya; (ई), f. a kind
of drum.
झाला झाला, f. = झला, q. v.
झलि झलि, इस्, f. the areca-nut.

झालि झालि, इस्, f. a sort of sour or unripe
mango fried with salt, mustard, and Asa Fœtida.

झल्लकण्ठ झल्लकण्ठ, अस्, m. a pigeon;
[cf. झिल्ली-कण्ठ.]

झल्लना झल्लना, f. a particular Prākṛt
metre.

झल्लिका झल्लिका, f. a rag or cloth used for
applying colour or perfumes; dirt rubbed off the body
by the application of perfumes; light, splendor, lustre;
[cf. झिल्लिका.]

झल्लीषक झल्लीषक, a sort of musical
instrument.

झल्लोल झल्लोल, अस्, m. a ball or protuber-
ance at the lower end of a spindle.
